cache_witness.candidate: Actual private committed records required before/after every native command boundary. Record count, bytes and SHA inventory; do not require collision slots to remain unchanged.
cache_witness.witness_scope: Magic, key-to-slot relation, bounded private regular files and supported JSON shape; no independent keyed-BLAKE3 or hit-count claim.

disk.capacity_rule: Both private AA baseline copies plus separate AB arm copies, all 68 full output sets for two 8-pair phases plus excluded pairs, original banks preserved; bind actual sizes before setup.

effect_barrier: Both complete 16-record raw/restoration gates before reading any durations; validate every typed duration across both hosts before either summary. AA and AB are disjoint.
margin_formula: One excluded full AA pair per host; discard individual timer returns. Common finish=ceil_to_10s(1.5*max(host aggregate pair ns)); entry=finish+30, entry<=240. No timed comparisons before exact aggregate/raw acceptance.
output_rule: Fresh per-host, per-label singleton exact uv check rmeta rules and complete ordinary diagnostics; no inherited rlib/ELF or metadata equivalence exceptions. Preserve raw outputs/exit before decoder; complete child and freshness/restoration gates.

regression_gate.replication: both hosts independently; withhold PR even for a small statistically replicated slowdown

publication: Both native gain gates are needed for a wall-speed claim. Both replicated regression gates withhold the PR. Any other AB result is inconclusive, not proof of no regression; one-host regression requires explicit review. AA failure closes native without AB. Primary/cold/source decisions remain independently required.

quiescence.ambiguity: preserve both roots; never guess a kill target or reuse paths

source_edit: Use the exact accepted donor fixture: append a deterministic ordinary non-doc comment, warm its state=before form, then change it to state=after_. The strings have equal length and five changed bytes. All Rust tokens and source positions remain unchanged. Restore the original source afterward; no production uv change.

state_recipe.aa: Two isolated full copies of the authenticated source-only baseline warm bank; baseline Cargo in both; private registry cache absent.
state_recipe.ab: Separate new full copies of each authenticated source-only primary arm bank; candidate cache actually populated; no reuse of AA-mutated banks.
state_recipe.both: Rolling equal-length comment edit, before-state native warm and zero-compiler freshness before each pair; canonical paths, driver dev/inode/ctime, content/mode/mtime and namespace bound; copied rustc_info inode explicitly rebound; no cross-host compiled state.

stopping.aa_failure: Close native; no AB, no wall claim.
stopping.ab_failure: Report valid negative or inconclusive without extra samples; never pool hosts.
stopping.operational: Preserve invalid packet/effects unread, restore only positively owned state and close; no replacement/retry/extension.

timer: perf_counter_ns immediately before Popen through ordinary Cargo wait; all descendants must positively drain before moving or reusing any path
